## .github/workflows/checks.yml

````yaml
name: Verify site
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  engineering:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Mobile performance budgets
        run: npx lhci autorun
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cloudflare-static-export
          path: out
````

## README.md

````markdown
# Driveway Calculators

A researched draft build for **drivewaycalc.online**, using Next.js App Router, strict TypeScript, Tailwind, MDX, and a static export for Cloudflare Pages connected to GitHub.

## File tree

```text
driveway-calculators/
├── app/                         # One route per map URL, homepage, trust pages
├── components/                  # Calculator UI, source and trust modules
├── content/                     # 51 MDX drafts with Section 11 keywords
├── data/
│   ├── pages.json               # 51 rows: 10 / 18 / 22 / 1 by phase
│   ├── source-metadata.json     # Document fields for regression checks
│   ├── defaults.json            # Exact conversions; other values null
│   ├── prices.json              # Prices, fees, tiers, and lifespans null
│   ├── sources.json             # Empty approved source register
│   ├── reviewers.json           # Empty; no appointed reviewer invented
│   ├── launch-checklist.json
│   └── schema.sql               # D1 lead and rate-limit tables
├── lib/calc/                    # Pure functions; UI uses this same engine
├── lib/seo/                     # Metadata and structured data
├── functions/api/lead.ts        # Cloudflare Pages Function; disabled
├── tests/                       # Arithmetic, metadata, edge cases, disabled leads
├── scripts/                     # Content, launch, and export validation
├── public/                      # Favicon and Cloudflare security headers
├── .github/workflows/checks.yml
├── docs/
│   ├── BUILD-STATUS.md
│   ├── DESIGN-REVIEW.md         # Reference design and shared theme
│   └── SOURCE-REVIEW.md          # File tree, every text file in full, commands
├── next.config.ts
└── package.json
```

## Private review preview

https://driveway-calculators-review.ekselllondon.chatgpt.site

The review preview is separate from the planned GitHub → Cloudflare Pages production deployment. All 51 mapped pages remain drafts. Shared metadata, navigation, homepage cards, and calculator introductions have been corrected across the site.

## Project One design adaptation

The reference design at https://www.projectone.website/ is adapted to the driveway tools: off-white, charcoal, and lime colors; a dark pill navigation bar; a centered oversized hero with floating calculator mockups; mixed-color tool tiles; staggered process cards; curved dark sections; a lime FAQ panel; and a large footer wordmark. Code-native SVG driveway illustrations replace the reference's agency project imagery. Shared styles carry the same theme into all calculators, guides, and trust pages.

See `docs/DESIGN-REVIEW.md` for the design mapping and verification limits.

## Sitewide screenshot corrections

Draft source placeholders stay in the MDX and data registers; the review UI presents clear pending-data states. Empty price tables are replaced by quote-input guidance. Calculator input tables explain units and supplier values. Rectangular and tapered diagrams follow the selected shape; optional bags and delivery loads use explicit expandable controls. Shared labels, help text, table text, bylines, and related links use larger type. Draft bylines avoid a publication update date, unappointed reviewer text is omitted, and related links appear once with useful descriptions.

## Run locally

Use Node.js 22 or later.

```sh
npm ci
npm run dev
```

Open the localhost address printed by Next.js. The provided `out/` directory is a compiled draft, but the source project is the authoritative deliverable. Next.js static exports require a web server for full behavior; opening `index.html` as a file is insufficient.

## Check and build

```sh
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
```

`npm run build` validates the map and frontmatter, exports the site to `out`, and checks the exported HTML. The source book contains every text file in full, with the dependency lockfile included in the project archive.

### GitHub → Cloudflare Pages

1. Use the project repository: https://github.com/yes155/driveway-calculator.
2. The source and dependency lockfile are maintained at the repository root on `main`. Keep `node_modules`, `.next`, and `.env` files out of Git.
3. Push future source changes to `main`.
4. In Cloudflare, choose Workers & Pages → Create → Pages → Connect to Git. Select that repository.
5. Use these build settings:

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Framework preset | Next.js (Static HTML Export) |
| Build command | `npm run build` |
| Build output directory | `out` |
| Root directory | Blank, when these files are at repository root |
| Node version | `22` |
| `SITE_STAGE` | `draft` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_LEADS_ENABLED` | `false` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_ADS_ENABLED` | `false` |

Cloudflare's Git integration rebuilds the static site after pushes. The top-level `functions/` folder supplies the separate Pages Function; this project has no Next.js API route.

Attach `drivewaycalc.online` only after the content and launch requirements pass. A draft uses noindex metadata, an empty sitemap, and disallow-all robots. These controls are not access control; use Cloudflare Access for a restricted review URL if needed.

Official deployment references:

- [Cloudflare: static Next.js on Pages](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/framework-guides/nextjs/deploy-a-static-nextjs-site/)
- [Cloudflare: build configuration](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/build-configuration/)
- [Next.js: static export](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/static-exports)

## Data and publication

The owner authorized source research. The evidence register now contains 134 named sources and 216 observations; see `docs/DATA-RESEARCH.md` and `data/research/source-values.csv`. Installed ranges retain one named publisher's scope, with conflicts recorded. Product and supplier examples remain labeled; no source ranges are silently averaged.

All 51 mapped pages now have source-grounded draft content. Quantity tools use editable named material references or user values. Cost tools use attributed baseline ranges with no regional adjustment, plus explicitly selected separate quote items. Unsupported national freight, annual upkeep, and regional values remain unavailable. Human review, contact/trust approval, and browser checks remain outstanding, so draft indexing controls stay enabled.

For each sourced entry record `value`, `unit`, `source`, `retrievedOn`, and `verified`. Add the corresponding named source and its URL to `data/sources.json`. External citation URLs belong on the Methodology page.

Each MDX page remains `status: draft`. Finish one page using its Table A/B rows, Section 11 keyword list, the provided DATA block, and the WRITE/AUDIT workflow. Add `answer`, `sourceNames`, `dataRequired`, and `defaultsUsed` to frontmatter; record human review in `data/launch-checklist.json` before changing its status to `published`.

The validator enforces metadata limits, URL existence, phase counts, exact keyword coverage, repeat limits, required context entities, question headings, disallowed hedging, and declared data/default dependencies for published content. It is not a substitute for the 15 editorial checks in Section 8.8 or human review. Keyword near-variants still need an explicit editorial exception mechanism before publication; none are silently accepted.

The launch build is deliberately blocked in this draft:

```sh
npm run build:launch
```

The Phase 1 set is published together. Seq 42 requires Seq 3–8. Seq 33 requires 8 published cost guides. Merged Seq 26, 28, 34, and 52 have no separate routes.

## Lead configuration: disabled

`QuoteCTA` renders nothing unless `NEXT_PUBLIC_LEADS_ENABLED=true`. The endpoint also requires `LEADS_ENABLED=true`, `NETWORK_APPROVED=true`, a D1 binding, and complete consent/network/Turnstile configuration. Frontend visibility never bypasses the server gate.

| Runtime setting | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `DB` | Cloudflare D1 binding; initialize with `data/schema.sql` |
| `LEADS_ENABLED` | Server enable flag |
| `NETWORK_APPROVED` | Written network approval recorded by the owner |
| `ALLOWED_ORIGIN` | Exact form origin, e.g. `https://drivewaycalc.online` |
| `NETWORK_CONSENT_TEXT` | Exact approved consent text; displayed unchanged |
| `NETWORK_SUCCESS_TEXT` | Exact approved acknowledgement; valid for stored/queued requests |
| `NETWORK_WEBHOOK_URL` | Approved HTTPS network endpoint |
| `NETWORK_WEBHOOK_TOKEN` | Optional authentication secret |
| `NETWORK_PHONE` | Optional tracking number, shown on mobile |
| `NETWORK_PHONE_REQUIRED` | Whether the network requires a phone |
| `TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` | Public site key |
| `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` | Secret verification key |
| `RATE_LIMIT_SALT` | Secret salt for hashed IP rate keys |

Consent is unchecked by default. The server validates input, origin, honeypot, consent, Turnstile hostname/action, and an atomic IP rate limit. It stores the exact displayed consent and timestamp. The network request retries up to 3 times. Persistent failures retain `status=failed` for operator retry. This build has no scheduled retry worker or lead-management screen; configure monitoring and a retention/deletion procedure before enabling collection. There is no PII logging or PII analytics payload.

### Required integration checks before enabling leads

| Case | Expected result |
| --- | --- |
| Flag disabled or incomplete network configuration | 503, no data stored |
| Wrong origin | 403, no data stored |
| Invalid ZIP, missing email, unchecked consent | 400 |
| Honeypot populated | 400 |
| Expired or wrong-host Turnstile token | 400 |
| Duplicate identical request identifier | Existing acceptance status; no second row |
| Reused identifier with different fields | 409 |
| Rate limit exceeded | 429 |
| D1 unavailable | 503; no personal information in logs |
| Network unavailable | Retry 3 times, retain failed status for operator retry |

Only disabled-path tests are executed locally. D1, Turnstile, and webhook integration tests require an approved staging configuration.

## Ads, affiliates, and analytics

Ads are disabled. `AdSlot` reserves height only when enabled; no ad-network script is installed. Affiliate products and links await approved data. No unsupported product recommendation is included.

GA4 is optional and absent by default. A configured GA4 script loads after the first pointer interaction. Events contain a tool identifier, never form data or shared URL query parameters. Search Console verification and sitemap submission remain owner setup tasks.

## Verification limits

The static build, source validator, export checks, and 128 tests pass. Browser interaction, keyboard/phone checks, Lighthouse, field INP, and live lead integrations were not executed in the build environment. GitHub Actions includes a mobile Lighthouse job for home, asphalt tool, and asphalt cost guide, with the requested score/LCP/CLS budgets. Total blocking time is a lab diagnostic; it does not verify field INP.

The source is synchronized to https://github.com/yes155/driveway-calculator. Cloudflare Pages account setup and its Git integration remain unverified.
````

## app/about/page.tsx

````tsx
import Link from 'next/link';
import { metadataFor, JsonLd, breadcrumbs } from '@/lib/seo';
export const metadata = metadataFor({
  title: 'About',
  description: 'This site focuses on driveway cost guides and material quantity calculators.',
  url: '/about/',
});
export default function Page() {
  return (
    <div className="trust-container">
      <span className="eyebrow">About the site</span>
      <h1>About</h1>
      <div className="prose">
        <p>
          <strong>
            This site focuses on driveway cost guides and material quantity calculators.
          </strong>
        </p>
        <p>
          {
            'The tools use US units and show their calculation formulas. Material defaults and price ranges require source records before publication.'
          }
        </p>
        <p>
          Read the <Link href="/methodology/">Methodology</Link> for calculation and source details.
        </p>
      </div>
      <JsonLd data={breadcrumbs({ h1: 'About', url: '/about/' })} />
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
      <span className="eyebrow">About the site</span>
      <h1>Contact</h1>
      <div className="prose">
        <p>
          <strong>The contact page awaits a verified publisher contact method.</strong>
        </p>
        <p>A public contact method has not been added to this review preview.</p>
        <p>
          Read the <Link href="/methodology/">Methodology</Link> for calculation and source details.
        </p>
      </div>
      <JsonLd data={breadcrumbs({ h1: 'Contact', url: '/contact/' })} />
    </div>
  );
}
````

## app/globals.css

````css
@import 'tailwindcss';
:root {
  --paper: #fafaf8;
  --white: #fff;
  --ink: #1d1e1b;
  --muted: #63655e;
  --line: #d9dad2;
  --lime: #c7ff52;
  --cream: #f0f0e5;
  --pale: #f2f3ed;
  --mono: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;
  --font: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
}
* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  scroll-padding-top: 24px;
}
body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font);
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color-scheme: light;
}
a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}
button,
input,
select {
  font: inherit;
}
button,
a,
input,
select,
summary {
  outline-offset: 4px;
}
a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
select:focus-visible,
summary:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #727d63;
}
button,
summary {
  cursor: pointer;
}
button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
h1,
h2,
h3,
p {
  margin-top: 0;
}
h1,
h2,
h3 {
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.06;
  letter-spacing: -0.055em;
}
h1 {
  font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
}
h2 {
  font-size: clamp(34px, 4.4vw, 56px);
}
h3 {
  font-size: 25px;
}
p {
  color: var(--muted);
}
mark {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--lime);
  padding: 0 0.08em;
  box-decoration-break: clone;
  -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone;
}
.eyebrow {
  font: 11px/1.5 var(--mono);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
}
.accent-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--lime);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  margin-right: 8px;
}
.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  top: -100px;
  left: 20px;
  z-index: 50;
  background: var(--lime);
  padding: 12px 20px;
}
.skip-link:focus {
  top: 10px;
}
.button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 7px 7px 7px 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.3;
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--ink);
  transition:
    transform 0.18s ease,
    box-shadow 0.18s ease;
}
.button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--ink);
}
.button.primary {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--lime);
}
.button > span:last-child {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--lime);
  background: var(--ink);
  font-size: 21px;
  border-radius: 2px;
}
.button.secondary {
  background: white;
  color: var(--ink);
  padding: 12px 16px;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.dark-button {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: white;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.dark-button > span:last-child {
  background: var(--lime);
  color: var(--ink);
}
.arrow-box {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--lime);
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-size: 21px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.site-header {
  background: var(--paper);
  position: relative;
  z-index: 20;
}
.header-inner {
  max-width: 1320px;
  margin: auto;
  padding: 24px 32px 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  position: relative;
}
.brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.brand-mark {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--lime);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
}
.brand-mark svg {
  width: 23px;
  height: 23px;
}
.site-header nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 7px 17px;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: white;
  border-radius: 30px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.nav-group {
  position: relative;
}
.nav-trigger {
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  padding: 9px 0;
  font: inherit;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.nav-trigger > span {
  margin-left: 5px;
  color: var(--lime);
}
.nav-trigger:hover,
.nav-about:hover {
  color: var(--lime);
}
.nav-about {
  padding: 9px 0;
}
.nav-dropdown {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 15px);
  left: -10px;
  width: 305px;
  max-height: 65dvh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 9px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--ink);
  z-index: 30;
}
.nav-group:nth-child(n + 3) .nav-dropdown {
  left: auto;
  right: -10px;
}
.nav-dropdown[hidden] {
  display: none;
}
.nav-dropdown a {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 9px 11px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.nav-dropdown a:last-child {
  border: 0;
}
.nav-dropdown a:hover {
  background: var(--lime);
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.header-tool {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: var(--lime);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 7px 7px 7px 13px;
}
.header-tool span {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--lime);
  width: 25px;
  height: 25px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}
.draft-banner {
  padding: 6px 20px;
  text-align: center;
  background: var(--cream);
  color: #606356;
  font-size: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.section-wrap {
  max-width: 1160px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}
.home-hero {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 1320px;
  min-height: 630px;
  margin: auto;
  padding: 83px 28px 100px;
  isolation: isolate;
}
.hero-halo {
  position: absolute;
  width: 640px;
  height: 620px;
  left: 50%;
  top: -45px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: #f2f2ef;
  border-radius: 50%;
  z-index: -1;
}
.hero-copy {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 630px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
  z-index: 2;
}
.hero-kicker {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.hero-copy h1 {
  font-size: clamp(58px, 7.1vw, 96px);
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: -0.066em;
  line-height: 0.97;
  margin-bottom: 27px;
}
.hero-copy h1 em {
  font-style: normal;
}
.hero-description {
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  max-width: 470px;
  margin: 0 auto 25px;
  color: #43453f;
}
.hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
}
.hero-footnote {
  display: block;
  font-size: 12px;
  margin: 22px 0 0;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.hero-footnote span {
  margin: 0 7px;
}
.hero-collage {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.orbit-card {
  position: absolute;
  width: 192px;
  padding: 9px;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 7px;
  box-shadow: 7px 8px 0 #d9dbd1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transition:
    transform 0.2s ease,
    box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}
.orbit-card:hover {
  z-index: 5;
  box-shadow: 10px 12px 0 #c7ff52;
}
.orbit-1 {
  left: 3.5%;
  top: 53px;
  transform: rotate(-12deg);
}
.orbit-2 {
  right: 3.5%;
  top: 25px;
  transform: rotate(14deg);
}
.orbit-3 {
  left: 12%;
  bottom: 48px;
  transform: rotate(-14deg);
}
.orbit-4 {
  right: 12%;
  bottom: 42px;
  transform: rotate(12deg);
}
.mockup-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 7px;
  color: var(--muted);
  padding: 0 1px 7px;
}
.mockup-dots {
  font-size: 5px;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.material-graphic {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
}
.mockup-title {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.2;
  padding: 10px 0 4px;
}
.mockup-unit {
  display: inline-block;
  font: 8px/1.3 var(--mono);
  background: var(--lime);
  padding: 3px 5px;
}
.hero-handwritten {
  position: absolute;
  right: 31%;
  bottom: 43px;
  transform: rotate(-8deg);
  font:
    italic 16px/1.2 Georgia,
    serif;
}
.project-intro {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.05fr;
  gap: 75px;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  padding: 65px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  position: relative;
}
.planning-list {
  background: #272822;
  border: 1px solid #494c40;
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 12px;
  transform: rotate(-2deg);
}
.planning-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 54px;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #42453a;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #d2d5c7;
}
.planning-row > span:last-child {
  margin-left: auto;
  font: 10px var(--mono);
  color: #868c79;
}
.step-check {
  font-size: 12px;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border: 1px solid #687357;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: var(--lime);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.planning-active {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--lime);
  border-radius: 3px;
  border: 0;
  margin: 5px -2px;
}
.planning-active .step-check {
  color: var(--ink);
  border-color: var(--ink);
}
.planning-active > span:last-child {
  color: var(--ink);
}
.planning-link {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 12px;
  padding: 15px 10px 5px;
  color: var(--lime);
}
.intro-copy .eyebrow {
  color: #b9c1a7;
}
.intro-copy h2 {
  font-size: clamp(35px, 4vw, 50px);
  margin: 20px 0;
}
.intro-copy p {
  color: #c2c8b5;
  font-size: 16px;
  max-width: 380px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.handwritten {
  display: inline-block;
  color: var(--lime);
  font:
    italic 18px/1.2 Georgia,
    serif;
  transform: rotate(-5deg);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--lime);
}
.home-section {
  max-width: 1160px;
  margin: auto;
  padding: 85px 28px;
}
.section-title {
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 670px;
  margin: 0 auto 44px;
}
.section-title .eyebrow {
  color: var(--muted);
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 17px;
}
.section-title h2 {
  margin: 0 0 22px;
}
.section-title p {
  font-size: 16px;
  max-width: 500px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.tool-bento {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
}
.tool-tile {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 285px;
  padding: 27px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 7px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--ink);
  transition: transform 0.2s;
}
.tool-tile:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}
.tile-dark {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: white;
}
.tile-dark p {
  color: #c9cdbc;
}
.tile-dark .arrow-box {
  background: var(--lime);
  color: var(--ink);
}
.tile-lime {
  background: var(--lime);
}
.tile-lime p {
  color: #424d2e;
}
.tile-cream {
  background: var(--cream);
}
.tile-icon {
  font-size: 27px;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 38px;
}
.tool-tile h3 {
  font-size: 26px;
  line-height: 1.08;
  margin: 0 0 15px;
}
.tool-tile p {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}
.tile-bottom {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-top: auto;
}
.steps-section {
  padding-top: 25px;
}
.process-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 14px;
}
.process-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--lime);
  padding: 26px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--ink);
}
.process-card:nth-child(2) {
  background: var(--cream);
  transform: translateY(24px);
}
.process-card:nth-child(3) {
  background: var(--lime);
  transform: translateY(48px);
}
.process-number {
  display: inline-block;
  font: 11px var(--mono);
  margin-bottom: 35px;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--lime);
  padding: 5px 8px;
  border-radius: 2px;
}
.process-card h3 {
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}
.process-card p {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #48523b;
  line-height: 1.65;
}
.process-equation {
  font: 11px/1.6 var(--mono);
  border-top: 1px solid #1d1e1b3b;
  display: block;
  padding-top: 16px;
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.lime-ticker {
  margin-top: 30px;
  padding: 17px 24px;
  background: var(--lime);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
  text-align: center;
  font: 12px/1.6 var(--mono);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.035em;
}
.lime-ticker b {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 400;
  margin: 0 24px;
}
.purpose-section {
  padding: 90px 24px 160px;
  color: white;
  background: var(--ink);
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.purpose-section::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  height: 135px;
  width: 120%;
  bottom: -85px;
  left: -10%;
  border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0;
  background: var(--cream);
}
.purpose-section > .eyebrow {
  color: #c7ceba;
}
.purpose-section h2 {
  margin: 26px auto 22px;
  max-width: 650px;
}
.purpose-section p {
  color: #c2c8b6;
  max-width: 450px;
  margin: 0 auto 30px;
  font-size: 16px;
}
.purpose-formula {
  position: absolute;
  top: 145px;
  display: block;
  font: 15px/1.7 var(--mono);
  text-align: left;
  padding: 21px;
  border: 1px solid #626854;
  background: #2b2e24;
  box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #0e100b;
  border-radius: 5px;
}
.purpose-formula strong {
  color: var(--lime);
  font-size: 18px;
}
.purpose-formula > span {
  display: block;
  font-size: 10px;
  margin-top: 10px;
  color: #b8c4a3;
}
.formula-left {
  left: max(4%, calc((100vw - 1200px) / 2));
  transform: rotate(-13deg);
}
.formula-right {
  right: max(4%, calc((100vw - 1200px) / 2));
  transform: rotate(12deg);
}
.surface-section {
  background: var(--cream);
  max-width: none;
  padding: 40px max(28px, calc((100vw - 1104px) / 2)) 85px;
}
.surface-gallery {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 15px;
}
.material-card {
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 7px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--ink);
  transition: transform 0.2s;
}
.material-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
}
.material-card .material-graphic {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 0;
}
.material-card > div {
  position: relative;
  padding: 23px 20px 65px;
}
.material-card h3 {
  font-size: 29px;
  margin: 12px 0 10px;
}
.material-card p {
  font-size: 13px;
  margin: 0;
}
.material-card .arrow-box {
  position: absolute;
  right: 17px;
  bottom: 18px;
}
.material-concrete > div,
.material-paver > div {
  background: var(--lime);
}
.library-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 22px;
}
.library-column {
  padding: 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: white;
}
.library-column h3 {
  font-size: 21px;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  padding-bottom: 18px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink);
}
.library-column > a {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 13px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.library-column a:hover > span:first-child {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.library-column a > span:last-child {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.faq-section {
  background: var(--lime);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 42px 45px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--ink);
}
.faq-section h2 {
  font-size: 52px;
  margin: 15px 0 30px;
}
.faq-list details {
  border-top: 1px solid #1d1e1b45;
}
.faq-list details:last-child {
  border-bottom: 1px solid #1d1e1b45;
}
.faq-list summary {
  display: flex;
  gap: 25px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 20px 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.faq-toggle {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-size: 23px;
  font-weight: 400;
  transition: transform 0.2s;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.faq-list details[open] .faq-toggle {
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}
.faq-list p {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #334023;
  max-width: 820px;
  margin: 0 40px 23px 0;
}
.faq-footer {
  margin-top: 27px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 25px;
  font-size: 15px;
}
.final-cta {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 95px 24px;
}
.final-cta h2 {
  margin: 22px 0;
}
.final-cta p {
  font-size: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}
.site-footer {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  padding: 50px max(28px, calc((100vw - 1160px) / 2)) 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.footer-main {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 60px;
}
.footer-brand {
  font-size: 27px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.055em;
}
.footer-main p {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #b9c0a8;
  margin-top: 15px;
}
.footer-main > div > .eyebrow {
  display: block;
  color: var(--lime);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.footer-main > div > a:not(.footer-brand) {
  display: block;
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 11px;
}
.footer-main a:hover {
  color: var(--lime);
}
.footer-bottom {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 25px;
  margin-top: 45px;
  border-top: 1px solid #41463a;
  padding: 22px 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #b9c0a8;
}
.footer-bottom > div {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 22px;
}
.footer-watermark {
  font-size: clamp(75px, 14vw, 182px);
  letter-spacing: -0.075em;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 0.9;
  padding: 28px 0 0;
  color: #30322a;
  text-align: center;
  user-select: none;
}
.footer-watermark > span {
  display: block;
}
/* Shared content and calculators use the same palette, type, and panel language. */
.page-container {
  max-width: 1216px;
  margin: auto;
  padding: 30px 40px;
}
.breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}
.breadcrumb a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.page-heading {
  max-width: 970px;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}
.page-heading > .eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 5px 9px;
  background: var(--lime);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-size: 10px;
}
.page-heading h1 {
  font-size: clamp(34px, 4vw, 51px);
  margin: 15px 0;
  line-height: 1.08;
}
.answer-block {
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}
.answer-block strong {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.byline {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.byline a {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.tool-page {
  padding-top: 22px;
}
.tool-page .breadcrumb {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.tool-page .page-heading {
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}
.tool-page .page-heading h1 {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 3.5vw, 46px);
}
.calculator-shell {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  background: white;
  border-radius: 9px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--ink);
  scroll-margin-top: 20px;
}
.calculator-inputs {
  padding: 30px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.calculator-output {
  padding: 30px;
  min-width: 0;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: white;
}
.calculator-output p {
  color: #c7cebb;
}
.panel-heading {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.unit-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 4px 7px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font: 10px/1.4 var(--mono);
}
.status-dot {
  font: 10px/1.5 var(--mono);
  color: #c7cebb;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.status-dot::before {
  content: '';
  display: inline-block;
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  background: var(--lime);
  border-radius: 50%;
  margin-right: 6px;
}
fieldset {
  border: 0;
  margin: 0 0 20px;
  padding: 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
legend {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.measurement-section + .measurement-section {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding-top: 20px;
}
.field-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 15px;
}
.field {
  display: block;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0 0 17px;
}
.field > span:first-child {
  display: block;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.field small {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-weight: 400;
}
.field > small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 7px;
}
.input-wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid #72786a;
  background: white;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 49px;
}
.input-wrap:focus-within {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ink);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.input-wrap input {
  border: 0;
  outline: none;
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
  font-size: 17px;
  padding: 11px 12px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.input-wrap > span {
  font: 11px/1.4 var(--mono);
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--muted);
  padding-right: 10px;
}
.field > input,
.field select {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 49px;
  border: 1px solid #72786a;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 12px;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: white;
}
.check {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin: 5px 0;
  min-height: 30px;
}
.check input {
  accent-color: var(--ink);
  width: 17px;
  height: 17px;
  margin: 0;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.section-options {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.add-section {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 43px;
  border: 1px dashed #a3aa96;
  background: var(--pale);
  font-size: 13px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 9px;
}
.add-section:hover {
  background: var(--lime);
}
.input-hint {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 12px 0;
}
.subheading {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding-top: 23px;
  margin-top: 27px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.form-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 25px;
}
.form-actions .primary {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.form-actions .secondary {
  padding-left: 14px;
  padding-right: 14px;
}
.text-button {
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 5px 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.optional-inputs {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  margin-top: 8px;
}
summary {
  list-style: none;
}
summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.optional-inputs summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 10px 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.optional-inputs summary > span {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.optional-inputs summary::after {
  content: '+';
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.optional-inputs[open] summary::after {
  content: '−';
}
.optional-inputs[open] summary {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.error {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid #ae573a;
  background: #fff1e9;
  color: #922e17;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.empty-result {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 18px 0;
}
.empty-result .shape-diagram {
  max-width: 280px;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto 16px;
  display: block;
  color: var(--lime);
  opacity: 0.9;
}
.shape-diagram text {
  font: 9px var(--mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  fill: currentColor;
}
.shape-diagram .diagram-label {
  font-size: 10px;
}
.empty-result h3 {
  font-size: 27px;
  margin-bottom: 13px;
}
.empty-result p {
  max-width: 310px;
  margin: 0 auto 27px;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.empty-rule {
  display: block;
  font: 11px/1.5 var(--mono);
  padding-top: 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid #424839;
  color: #b8c2a6;
}
.conversion-diagram {
  padding: 38px 15px;
  margin: 20px 0 30px;
  border: 1px solid #66744f;
  color: var(--lime);
  font: 16px/1.8 var(--mono);
  border-radius: 5px;
}
.output-note {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 28px;
}
.output-note > span {
  font-size: 27px;
  color: var(--lime);
}
.output-note p {
  font-size: 12px;
  margin: 0;
}
.metrics {
  margin: 0;
}
.metrics > div {
  padding: 20px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #424839;
}
.metrics > div:first-child {
  padding-top: 5px;
}
.metrics dt {
  color: #c4ceaf;
  font: 11px/1.5 var(--mono);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.metrics dd {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(27px, 3.2vw, 42px);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.05em;
  line-height: 1.15;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  color: var(--lime);
}
.metrics dd small {
  display: inline-block;
  font: 12px var(--mono);
  color: #c7cebb;
  margin-left: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
.worked-inputs {
  font-size: 22px;
  margin-top: 30px;
}
.formula-box {
  background: var(--cream);
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 18px 20px;
  margin: 24px 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.formula-box > .eyebrow {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.formula-box code {
  display: block;
  font: 12px/1.8 var(--mono);
  white-space: normal;
}
.formula-box p {
  font-size: 13px;
  margin: 12px 0 0;
}
.calculator-output .formula-box {
  background: #2e3326;
  color: #eef3e5;
  border-color: #5c674b;
  border-left-color: var(--lime);
}
.calculator-output .formula-box > .eyebrow {
  color: var(--lime);
}
.result-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}
.result-actions button,
.helpful button {
  border: 1px solid #b7c3a0;
  background: transparent;
  border-radius: 4px;
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.result-actions button:hover {
  background: var(--lime);
  color: var(--ink);
}
.data-note {
  margin: 17px 0;
  background: #eef3df;
  border: 1px solid #b5c393;
  color: #455a26;
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.65;
}
.data-note p {
  color: inherit;
  font-size: 13px;
  margin: 5px 0 0;
}
.calculator-output .data-note p {
  color: inherit;
}
.surface-choices {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.checks {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.estimate-note {
  font-size: 12px;
  margin: 16px 0;
}
.result-assumptions {
  font-size: 13px;
}
.result-assumptions p {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.article-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 260px;
  gap: 65px;
  margin-top: 45px;
}
.prose {
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  min-width: 0;
}
.prose h2 {
  font-size: 29px;
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin: 35px 0 18px;
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
}
.prose h3 {
  font-size: 23px;
  margin-top: 30px;
}
.prose strong {
  color: var(--ink);
}
.prose ul {
  padding-left: 22px;
  list-style: disc;
}
.prose li {
  margin-bottom: 9px;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.prose a:not(.related-link a) {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.prose code {
  font: 13px/1.8 var(--mono);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.qa {
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.article-sidebar {
  align-self: start;
}
.side-box {
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  background: var(--lime);
  padding: 24px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--ink);
}
.side-box h3 {
  font-size: 26px;
  margin: 17px 0;
}
.side-box p {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: #475b2b;
}
.side-box > a {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 0 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #1d1e1b45;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.related-link {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding-top: 17px;
  margin: 17px 0;
}
.related-link > a {
  display: flex;
  gap: 15px;
  justify-content: space-between;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.related-link > a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.related-link > span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.source-note {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding-top: 22px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
.source-note p {
  margin: 8px 0;
}
.disclosure,
.editorial-status {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.helpful {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding-top: 25px;
  margin-top: 35px;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.table-scroll {
  overflow-x: auto;
}
table {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  width: 100%;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 20px 0;
}
th,
td {
  padding: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  text-align: left;
  vertical-align: top;
}
th {
  font-weight: 600;
}
thead {
  background: var(--cream);
}
caption {
  text-align: left;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.calculator-output table th,
.calculator-output table td {
  border-color: #5d6851;
}
.calculator-output thead {
  background: #2c3423;
  color: var(--lime);
}
.calculator-output caption {
  color: #c7cebb;
}
.ad-slot {
  min-height: 280px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  padding-top: 15px;
  background: var(--pale);
  font-size: 10px;
}
.quote-cta {
  border-top: 1px solid #5d6851;
  margin-top: 22px;
  padding-top: 22px;
}
.quote-cta h3 {
  font-size: 24px;
}
.quote-cta > p {
  font-size: 14px;
}
.quote-form {
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.honeypot {
  position: absolute;
  left: -10000px;
}
.mobile-call {
  display: none;
}
.not-found {
  padding: 100px 0;
}
.trust-container {
  max-width: 860px;
  margin: auto;
  padding: 55px 35px 65px;
}
.trust-container > .eyebrow {
  background: var(--lime);
  padding: 5px 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 3px;
}
.trust-container h1 {
  font-size: clamp(35px, 4vw, 51px);
  margin-top: 22px;
}
.trust-container .prose {
  margin-top: 30px;
}
@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .header-tool {
    display: none;
  }
  .header-inner {
    gap: 20px;
  }
  .site-header nav {
    gap: 15px;
  }
  .orbit-card {
    width: 166px;
  }
  .hero-copy {
    max-width: 550px;
  }
  .hero-copy h1 {
    font-size: 78px;
  }
  .orbit-1 {
    left: 2%;
    top: 72px;
  }
  .orbit-2 {
    right: 2%;
    top: 66px;
  }
  .project-intro,
  .faq-section {
    margin-left: 28px;
    margin-right: 28px;
  }
  .project-intro {
    gap: 45px;
    padding: 45px;
  }
  .purpose-formula {
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 14px;
  }
  .purpose-formula strong {
    font-size: 15px;
  }
  .formula-left {
    left: 2%;
  }
  .formula-right {
    right: 2%;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 940px) {
  .header-inner {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 16px;
  }
  .site-header nav {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .nav-group {
    position: static;
  }
  .nav-dropdown,
  .nav-group:nth-child(n + 3) .nav-dropdown {
    left: 28px;
    right: 28px;
    top: calc(100% + 6px);
    width: calc(100% - 56px);
  }
  .hero-copy h1 {
    font-size: 74px;
  }
  .hero-description {
    max-width: 420px;
    font-size: 16px;
  }
  .orbit-card {
    width: 140px;
  }
  .orbit-1 {
    top: 100px;
    left: 2%;
  }
  .orbit-2 {
    top: 100px;
    right: 2%;
  }
  .mockup-toolbar {
    font-size: 5px;
  }
  .mockup-title {
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .hero-handwritten {
    display: none;
  }
  .project-intro {
    gap: 30px;
    padding: 35px;
  }
  .intro-copy h2 {
    font-size: 36px;
  }
  .planning-row {
    font-size: 12px;
    gap: 9px;
  }
  .tool-tile {
    padding: 23px;
  }
  .tool-tile h3 {
    font-size: 23px;
  }
  .purpose-formula {
    display: none;
  }
  .purpose-section {
    padding-bottom: 130px;
  }
  .surface-gallery {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 18px;
  }
  .library-grid {
    gap: 14px;
  }
  .library-column {
    padding: 18px;
  }
  .library-column h3 {
    font-size: 19px;
  }
  .article-layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 25px;
  }
  .calculator-shell {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .article-sidebar {
    max-width: 500px;
  }
  .footer-main {
    gap: 30px;
    grid-template-columns: 1.7fr 1fr 1fr;
  }
  .page-container {

    margin-top: 20px;

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .home-hero {
    padding-top: 58px;
    padding-bottom: 50px;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .hero-copy {
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .hero-copy h1 {
    font-size: clamp(46px, 10vw, 74px);
  }
  .hero-halo {
    width: 96%;
    max-width: 600px;
    height: 530px;
    top: 0;
  }
  .hero-collage {
    position: relative;
    inset: auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 22px;
    max-width: 385px;
    margin: 60px auto 5px;
  }
  .orbit-card {
    width: auto;
    position: relative;
    inset: auto;
    padding: 9px;
  }
  .orbit-1,
  .orbit-3 {
    transform: rotate(-6deg);
  }
  .orbit-2,
  .orbit-4 {
    transform: rotate(6deg);
  }
  .mockup-toolbar {
    font-size: 6px;
  }
  .mockup-title {
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .project-intro {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 40px;
  }
  .planning-list {
    order: 2;
  }
  .intro-copy {
    text-align: center;
  }
  .intro-copy h2 {
    font-size: 43px;
  }
  .intro-copy p {
    margin: 0 auto 20px;
  }
  .planning-row {
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  .tool-bento {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
  .process-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
  }
  .process-card:nth-child(n) {
    transform: none;
  }
  .process-card {
    padding: 25px;
  }
  .process-number {
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .steps-section {
    padding-bottom: 50px;
  }
  .lime-ticker {
    margin-top: 0;
    font-size: 10px;
  }
  .lime-ticker b {
    margin: 0 10px;
  }
  .library-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 20px;
  }
  .library-column {
    padding: 24px;
  }
  .faq-section {
    padding: 30px;
  }
  .faq-footer {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  body {
    font-size: 16px;
  }
  .header-inner {
    padding: 18px 20px;
  }
  .brand {
    font-size: 18px;
  }
  .site-header nav {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    column-gap: 20px;
    row-gap: 0;
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 9px 15px;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }
  .nav-dropdown,
  .nav-group:nth-child(n + 3) .nav-dropdown {
    left: 20px;
    right: 20px;
    width: calc(100% - 40px);
  }
  .draft-banner {
    font-size: 11px;
    text-align: left;
    padding: 8px 20px;
  }
  .home-hero {
    padding: 48px 23px 45px;
  }
  .hero-copy h1 {
    font-size: clamp(43px, 11.5vw, 56px);
  }
  .hero-kicker {
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .hero-description {
    font-size: 15px;
  }
  .hero-description br {
    display: none;
  }
  .hero-footnote {
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .hero-footnote span {
    margin: 0 4px;
  }
  .hero-collage {
    gap: 19px;
    max-width: 330px;
  }
  .mockup-title {
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .mockup-toolbar {
    font-size: 5px;
  }
  .mockup-unit {
    font-size: 7px;
  }
  .project-intro,
  .faq-section {
    margin-left: 20px;
    margin-right: 20px;
    padding: 27px 22px;
  }
  .intro-copy h2 {
    font-size: 38px;
  }
  .planning-row {
    font-size: 12px;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .home-section {
    padding: 55px 20px;
  }
  .section-title {
    margin-bottom: 32px;
  }
  .section-title h2 {
    font-size: 36px;
  }
  .section-title p {
    font-size: 15px;
  }
  .tool-bento {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 17px;
  }
  .tool-tile {
    min-height: 240px;
    padding: 27px;
  }
  .tool-tile h3 {
    font-size: 28px;
  }
  .tile-icon {
    margin-bottom: 27px;
  }
  .purpose-section {
    padding: 65px 20px 110px;
  }
  .purpose-section h2 {
    font-size: 37px;
  }
  .surface-section {
    padding-top: 20px;
  }
  .surface-gallery {
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .material-card > div {
    padding: 17px 14px 59px;
  }
  .material-card h3 {
    font-size: 25px;
  }
  .material-card p {
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .material-card .eyebrow {
    font-size: 9px;
  }
  .faq-section h2 {
    font-size: 43px;
  }
  .faq-list summary {
    font-size: 15px;
    padding: 17px 0;
    gap: 13px;
  }
  .faq-list p {
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-right: 0;
  }
  .final-cta h2 {
    font-size: 38px;
  }
  .page-container {
    padding: 22px 20px;
  }
  .tool-page {
    padding-top: 20px;
  }
  .page-heading h1,
  .tool-page .page-heading h1 {
    font-size: 32px;
  }
  .page-heading > .eyebrow {
    font-size: 9px;
  }
  .answer-block {
    font-size: 16px;
  }
  .byline {
    font-size: 12px;
    gap: 7px;
  }
  .breadcrumb {
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .calculator-inputs,
  .calculator-output {
    padding: 22px;
  }
  .panel-heading {
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .panel-heading .eyebrow,
  .status-dot {
    font-size: 10px;
  }
  .field-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 0;
  }
  .field > span:first-child {
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .input-wrap input {
    padding: 10px;
  }
  .input-wrap > span {
    font-size: 12px;
    padding-right: 7px;
  }
  .form-actions {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .form-actions .primary {
    flex: 1 1 180px;
    padding-left: 13px;
    gap: 12px;
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .form-actions .secondary {
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .prose {
    font-size: 16px;
  }
  .prose h2 {
    font-size: 26px;
  }
  .side-box {
    padding: 23px;
  }
  .trust-container {
    padding: 40px 22px;
  }
  .trust-container h1 {
    font-size: 35px;
  }
  .footer-main {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 26px;
  }
  .footer-main > div:first-child {
    grid-column: 1/-1;
  }
  .footer-brand {
    font-size: 25px;
  }
  .site-footer {
    padding: 40px 22px 0;
  }
  .footer-bottom {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 14px;
    margin-top: 25px;
  }
  .footer-bottom > div {
    gap: 18px;
  }
  .footer-watermark {
    font-size: clamp(44px, 15vw, 70px);
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    transition: none !important;
    animation: none !important;
  }
}
@media print {
  .site-header,
  .draft-banner,
  .site-footer,
  .breadcrumb,
  .calculator-inputs,
  .article-layout,
  .result-actions,
  .quote-cta,
  .skip-link {
    display: none !important;
  }
  body {
    background: white;
    color: black;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  main {
    width: 100%;
  }
  .page-container {
    padding: 0;
    max-width: none;
  }
  .page-heading {
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .page-heading h1,
  .tool-page .page-heading h1 {
    font-size: 24px;
  }
  .answer-block {
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .calculator-shell {
    display: block;
    border: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .calculator-output {
    padding: 0;
    background: white;
    color: black;
  }
  .calculator-output p,
  .metrics dt,
  .metrics dd,
  .metrics dd small {
    color: black;
  }
  .metrics {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .metrics > div {
    padding: 10px 0;
    border-color: #aaa;
  }
  .metrics dd {
    font-size: 24px;
  }
  .formula-box,
  .calculator-output .formula-box {
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 10px;
    margin: 15px 0;
    color: black;
    background: white;
    border-color: #aaa;
    break-inside: avoid;
  }
  .formula-box code {
    font-size: 10px;
  }
  .calculator-output .formula-box > .eyebrow {
    color: black;
  }
  .calculator-output .panel-heading {
    margin: 15px 0;
  }
  .status-dot {
    color: black;
  }
  .byline {
    font-size: 9px;
  }
  .data-note {
    font-size: 10px;
  }
  .page-heading,
  .calculator-output {
    break-inside: avoid;
  }
}

/* Research and task-first refinements apply to every page. */
.hero-actions {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.hero-materials {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 18px 0;
}
.hero-materials a {
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.hero-copy {
  max-width: 640px;
}
.home-hero {
  min-height: 660px;
}
.reference-panel {
  margin: 30px 0;
}
.reference-panel p {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.reference-panel .source-caption {
  font-size: 13px;
}
.benchmark-note {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  background: var(--cream);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 12px;
}
.text-button {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--cream);
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 13px;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  text-align: left;
}
.metrics > div:first-child dd {
  font-size: clamp(38px, 4vw, 56px);
}
.metrics > div:not(:first-child) dd {
  font-size: 26px;
}
.research-details {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  padding: 14px 16px;
  margin: 20px 0;
  border-radius: 5px;
}
.research-details > summary {
  font-weight: 700;
}
.source-register {
  padding-left: 20px;
}
.source-register li {
  margin: 15px 0;
  font-size: 14px;
}
.source-register a {
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.article-sidebar .side-box {
  background: var(--cream);
  box-shadow: none;
}
.article-sidebar .side-box h3 {
  font-size: 24px;
}
.site-footer:not(.footer-home) .footer-watermark {
  display: none;
}
.site-footer:not(.footer-home) {
  padding-bottom: 24px;
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .home-hero {
    min-height: auto;
  }
  .hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .hero-actions .button {
    width: max-content;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .research-details {
    padding: 12px;
  }
}
````

````tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import './globals.css';
import Header from '@/components/Header';
import Footer from '@/components/Footer';
import Analytics from '@/components/Analytics';
import { JsonLd, organization } from '@/lib/seo';
import { SITE } from '@/lib/config';
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  metadataBase: new URL(SITE.url),
  title: SITE.name,
  description: 'Driveway cost guides and material calculators.',
  robots: { index: false, follow: true },
  icons: { icon: '/icon.svg' },
};
export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en-US">
      <body className="theme-projectone">
        <a href="#main" className="skip-link">
          Skip to content
        </a>
        <Header />
        {SITE.stage === 'draft' && (
          <div className="draft-banner">
            Development preview · Researched benchmarks; local quotes and material conditions
            govern.
          </div>
        )}
        <main id="main">{children}</main>
        <Footer />
        <JsonLd data={organization()} />
        <Analytics />
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import Link from 'next/link';
import { pages, getPage } from '@/lib/content';

import { breadcrumbs, JsonLd } from '@/lib/seo';
import HeroCollage from '@/components/HeroCollage';
import MaterialGraphic from '@/components/MaterialGraphic';
export const metadata = pageMetadata('/');
const featured = [
  {
    seq: 2,
    icon: '↗',
    tone: 'dark',
    description: 'Turn length, width, and thickness into asphalt short tons.',
  },
  {
    seq: 35,
    icon: '▦',
    tone: 'lime',
    description: 'Work out concrete cubic yards and optional bag quantities.',
  },
  {
    seq: 9,
    icon: '∴',
    tone: 'cream',
    description: 'Calculate gravel volume and weight with your supplier density.',
  },
  {
    seq: 8,
    icon: '≋',
    tone: 'cream',
    description: 'Keep base and surface layers separate, then add the totals.',
  },
  {
    seq: 36,
    icon: '▤',
    tone: 'lime',
    description: 'Count pavers and calculate base material and bedding sand.',
  },
  {
    seq: 21,
    icon: '◒',
    tone: 'dark',
    description: 'Use product-label coverage to calculate gallons and containers.',
  },
];
const materials = [
  {
    key: 'asphalt' as const,
    label: 'Asphalt',
    line: 'Thickness. Tonnage. Base work.',
    href: '/asphalt-driveway-cost/',
  },
  {
    key: 'concrete' as const,
    label: 'Concrete',
    line: 'Volume. Finish. Reinforcement.',
    href: '/concrete-driveway-cost/',
  },
  {
    key: 'gravel' as const,
    label: 'Gravel',
    line: 'Layers. Material weight. Delivery.',
    href: '/gravel-driveway-cost/',
  },
  {
    key: 'paver' as const,
    label: 'Pavers',
    line: 'Paver size. Base. Bedding sand.',
    href: '/paver-driveway-cost/',
  },
];
const faqs = [
  {
    question: 'Which units do these calculators use?',
    answer:
      'Measurements use feet and inches. Results use square feet, cubic yards, US short tons, bags, pavers, or gallons, depending on the tool.',
  },
  {
    question: 'Can I measure an irregular or tapered driveway?',
    answer:
      'Yes. Add separate measured sections and use the tapered-width option for different start and end widths. Each section contributes to the total area. Slope inputs account for the way you measured the length.',
  },
  {
    question: 'Where do I get the material density or product yield?',
    answer:
      'Use your supplier’s material density or the coverage and yield printed on the product label. The fields remain editable, so the result follows the material you are ordering.',
  },
  {
    question: 'Does the calculator include waste and compaction?',
    answer:
      'The relevant tools include separate allowance fields. Enter your project allowance, or enter 0 to exclude it. The worked calculation shows how the entered values affect the result.',
  },
  {
    question: 'Which prices do the estimators use?',
    answer:
      'The estimators use attributed published ranges with no regional adjustment. Sources differ in work scope. Delivery and supplier-specific charges come from your quote; unresolved figures remain unavailable.',
  },
  {
    question: 'Can I copy, print, or share my calculation?',
    answer:
      'Yes. Calculate a result to access copy, print, and share controls. A shared link contains the calculator inputs so you can reopen the same calculation.',
  },
];
export default function Home() {
  return (
    <>
      <section className="home-hero">
        <div className="hero-halo" aria-hidden="true" />
        <div className="hero-copy">
          <span className="eyebrow hero-kicker">
            <span className="accent-dot" />
            Your driveway, worked out.
          </span>
          <h1>
            Driveway
            <br />
            <em>Calculators.</em>
          </h1>
          <p className="hero-description">
            Your measurements. Your materials. The math in view.
            <br />
            Free tools for asphalt, concrete, gravel, and pavers.
          </p>
          <div className="hero-actions">
            <Link href="#workbench" className="button primary">
              Calculate material <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
            </Link>
            <Link href="/driveway-cost-calculator/" className="button secondary">
              Estimate project cost <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
            </Link>
          </div>
          <div className="hero-materials" aria-label="Choose your driveway material">
            {[
              { label: 'Asphalt', href: '/asphalt-calculator/' },
              { label: 'Concrete', href: '/concrete-calculator/' },
              { label: 'Gravel', href: '/gravel-driveway-calculator/' },
              { label: 'Pavers', href: '/paver-calculator/' },
            ].map((m) => (
              <Link href={m.href} key={m.label}>
                {m.label}
              </Link>

      <section className="home-section library-section" id="library">
        <div className="section-title">

            <mark>tool library.</mark>

        <div className="library-grid">

            { label: 'Quantity calculators', filter: (t: string) => t === 'Quantity tool' },
            { label: 'Cost estimators', filter: (t: string) => /estimator|Compare/.test(t) },
            {
              label: 'Material references',
              filter: (t: string) => /Reference|Converter|Spec/.test(t),
            },
          ].map((g) => (
            <div className="library-column" key={g.label}>
              <h3>{g.label}</h3>
              {pages
                .filter((p) => g.filter(p.type) && p.seq !== 1)
                .map((p) => (
                  <Link href={p.url} key={p.url}>
                    <span>{p.h1}</span>
                    <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
                  </Link>
                ))}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className="faq-section section-wrap" id="faqs">
        <span className="eyebrow">A few things to know</span>
        <h2>FAQs.</h2>
        <div className="faq-list">
          {faqs.map((faq) => (
            <details key={faq.question}>
              <summary>
                {faq.question}
                <span className="faq-toggle" aria-hidden="true">
                  +
                </span>
              </summary>
              <p>{faq.answer}</p>
            </details>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="faq-footer">
          <span>Want to inspect the formulas?</span>
          <Link href="/methodology/" className="button dark-button">
            Read the method <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className="home-section final-cta">
        <span className="eyebrow">Your next step</span>
        <h2>
          Start with
          <br />
          <mark>a measurement.</mark>
        </h2>
        <p>Choose a material calculator and work through your project.</p>
        <Link href="#workbench" className="button primary">
          Choose a calculator <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
        </Link>
      </section>
      <JsonLd data={breadcrumbs(getPage('/'))} />
    </>
  );
}
````
